title: Chart-of-accounts entry
description: Typed object form of a single general-ledger account in Bea's chart of accounts (per Team/Bea.md §11 — owned with Atlas). The chart is the canonical mapping from event flows to GL accounts; every PostingRulePublished event references account IDs from this register.

id.description: Stable GL account identifier. Convention: ACC-<TYPE><CATEGORY>-<NNN>. The four-digit prefix encodes the IFRS classification group (e.g., 1xxx assets, 2xxx liabilities, 3xxx equity, 4xxx income, 5xxx expense).

name.description: Human-readable account name. Currency-free: currency is a SEPARATE dimension (see `currency` / `currencies`), never embedded in the name (D-COA-CURRENCY-DECOUPLING, CEO-approved 2026-05-30).

currency.description: The account's designated ISO-4217 currency, as a first-class dimension. Currency is NEVER part of `name` (D-COA-CURRENCY-DECOUPLING, 2026-05-30). The authoritative per-balance currency is the currency dimension on each ledger entry; this field is the account's designated currency. Omitted only for genuinely multi-currency pool accounts. Distinct from `currencies` (the array of all currencies an account may hold); for single-currency accounts the two are consistent (currencies = [currency]).

side.description: Natural balance side. A debit-natural account increases on debit postings.

ifrsClassification.description: IFRS 9 classification (where applicable). Non-financial-instrument accounts use 'non-financial'.

currencies.description: ISO 4217 currencies in which this account holds balances. Per Principle 5, every account declares its currencies; no implicit default currency.

entityScope.description: Legal-entity IDs for which this account exists. References the legal-entity tree.

hqlaLevel.description: Basel III / BCBS LCR HQLA tier for this account, where applicable. Level-1: 0% haircut (central-bank reserves, sovereign debt 0% RW). Level-2A: 15% haircut (e.g. non-0%-RW sovereign, high-quality covered bonds, qualifying corporate bonds). Level-2B: 25–50% haircut (RMBS, qualifying equities, certain corporate bonds). Absent means the account does not contribute to the HQLA stock numerator. Authority: D-HQLA-COA-CLASSIFICATION; BCBS D295 §II.A (Jan 2013); SARB BA 325.

hqlaSubCategory.description: Free-form sub-category label for BA 325 line rendering (e.g. 'level-1.central-bank-reserves'). Only meaningful when hqlaLevel is set. Used as the lineLabel in Ba325LineItem by the generator. Authority: D-HQLA-COA-CLASSIFICATION; SARB BA 325.

hqlaAssetSpecificFactor.description: Per-asset haircut factor for level-2b accounts. Per BCBS D295 §54: minimum 0.50 for equities / non-RMBS; 0.25 for RMBS. Unset defaults to 0.50. Only meaningful when hqlaLevel === 'level-2b'. Authority: D-HQLA-COA-CLASSIFICATION; BCBS D295 §54.

line.description: Line / cell identifier within the form.

baReturnLines.description: BA-return cell mappings this account contributes to. Aggregation logic is canonical in the BA-return generator; the mapping declared here is the single source of truth.
